spell.openworld_rpg.arc_bolt.name: Arc Bolt
spell.openworld_rpg.arc_bolt.description: Launches a focused arcane bolt at the aimed enemy.
spell.openworld_rpg.radiant_lance.name: Radiant Lance
spell.openworld_rpg.radiant_lance.descri: Hurls a radiant lance at an enemy. Full Grace empowers its follow-up effect.
spell.openworld_rpg.mend.name: Mend
spell.openworld_rpg.mend.description: Restores health to the aimed ally or yourself.
spell.openworld_rpg.rebuke.name: Rebuke
spell.openworld_rpg.rebuke.description: Unleashes a frontal holy burst that damages, staggers, and weakens enemy direct damage.
spell.openworld_rpg.sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
spell.openworld_rpg.sanctuary.descriptio: Raises a holy ward that shields allies, restores health, and scorches enemies within its boundary.
